title: intent init's report of what it wrote omits intent/.config/config.json
body:
`intent init` prints the config, `intent/.config/config.json`, as the one ABSOLUTE path in the list of files it wrote; every other line is relative to the root the `created:` line names. So the file that makes the directory a project reads as a path somewhere else, and a reader scanning the list for it by its project path does not find it.

**Corrected 2026-09-19 by cc, by driving it.** The filing below said the list OMITS the config, and I filed vc's finding without running `init`. Driven on the 3.1.0 pair (11ce80ad5) in a scratch project, the report was:

    created: drive at /private/tmp/.../drive477/p
      author is unset -- run `intent bootstrap` to record it once for this machine, or set it in intent/.config/config.json
      /private/tmp/.../drive477/p/intent/.config/config.json
      .gitignore
      ...

`Initialised.config` is its own field, and `render.rs` printed it with `display()` where the loop below it prints each file `strip_prefix(&made.root)`. The defect is that inconsistency, not an omission.

Fix: the config line is printed relative, from the same stripped path the "author is unset" line already used, and `init_from_empty_dir.rs` pins every listed line as relative. XS.

Filed as:

> `intent init`'s report of what it wrote omits `intent/.config/config.json` while listing every other file it created. Found by vc during the 2026-09-19 doc sweep; cc filed it.
>
> `written` is filled only by the starter-content loop (`init.rs:367-371`). The config is written by a separate path, so it never enters the list the report prints. The only absence the code explains is `.prettierignore`'s, and that explanation (`init.rs:274`) belongs to the occupied-destination check, not to the report. The report of a fresh project therefore leaves out the one file that makes the directory a project.
>
> Fix: report the config as written (or, if its absence is deliberate, say why next to the report). XS.

CLOSED 2026-09-19, by the landing at fb80369ab on vc's GO (T1, patch-id d5f451ba35dd, judged green at f46411fd7: intentsvcs 1804 passed 0 failed, intent-cli 1034 passed 0 failed). render.rs prints the config from the same root-stripped path the "author is unset" line uses, and init_from_empty_dir.rs's init_lists_the_config_relative_like_every_other_file pins every listed line as relative.
